title: Page metadata catalogs and bound nested records across workspace, orchestration and federation APIs
outcome: Remaining host-owned catalogs have explicit page budgets and bounded detail projections instead of whole-store responses.
acceptance: Inventory and bound list/detail responses for workspaces, orchestrator templates/instances, session markers and overview markers, handoffs/named roots, mailbox catalogs/references/participants/directory, federation peers/journal/executor views, Codex MCP/model data and agent readiness.
Pagination occurs before collecting whole stores where feasible, and detail records have byte/depth/item budgets or bounded subresource pages; count-only limits are not presented as byte limits.

Existing route owners, authorities and cursor patterns are reused; clients retain referenced-but-not-loaded entities, exact lookup and truthful totals. No persistent history is deleted to shrink responses.
Tests validate budgets and continuation with small fixtures, including512 overview buckets plus many markers and nested Codex metadata; independent review and full gate pass.
